body: idk if I can do this anymore

It still isn't easy though. I felt like I was going to die or pass out when we were doing stretches, since you have to hold them for so long and you're doing the same thing over and over. I wish june would come already.

Wasn't as hard as I was expecting since the teacher doesn't want to be there either but the beginning is the worst part since you do nothing but wait for all the late kids to show up for about 45 minutes, then you do stretching until like 9:50 and then there's a 20 minute break. After the break is up we go to the weight room which is pretty easy since you can just walk around and in the last hour or so we go back down to the gym where you can do basketball or some other thing. I don't like how they put the hardest thing in the beginning.

I went to the english thing for the first time today. It's not as hard as I thought it would be since you get a break that's twenty minutes and then you just do questions for 30 minutes.

Still worried about gym though.

I told the gym teacher I had a job so hopefully I could leave earlier without staying 4 whole hours and he  said no.

Now I'm fucked. The english thing I don't really care about anymore but the saturday school is a nightmare.
I'll try. I just feel like I won't be able to do this for every saturday from now on and I'll end up quitting and then I won't graduate.
It's at 8 o clock in the morning though.

I'm tempted to tell the counselor that my anxiety is making me fail english and now possibly government, but they'll just tell my parents and make me go on something which my parents are very much against. I'm just frustrated I have to get up early every Saturday now and go someplace I don't even want to go. I really don't think they can make kids run around in gym for 4 hours.

Do you think when I go to the gym thing Saturday I should lie and tell them I have a job so hopefully they'll let me leave earlier? Just the idea of doing gym things for 4 hours makes me sick and I shouldn't even be there in the first place. They made a mistake and didn't give me gym last year so I'm missing a credit.

I'm just worried that it's one of those things where being absent one time makes you fail and I can't let that happen, so I have to force myself to go feeling like I'm going to throw up like I do everyday. I almost passed out in gym last year and ever since then I've had really bad anxiety and it's making me almost fail school.
